svg.aria-label: Pickroute (formerly CS2 IP Changer): a CS2 server picker for the 30 matchmaking regions, and CS2 over your phone’s mobile data so community servers only see your carrier’s IP. Never touches the game.

text.tspan: Choose which of CS2’s 30 matchmaking regions you queue in, with the ping of each. No phone needed.
CS2 plays over your phone’s mobile data, so community servers only see your carrier’s IP. Get a new

svg.text: one from the app, or with Ctrl+Shift+F10 in game.

text.tspan: · Never touches the game process, its memory or its program files.
